Terms of use

The terms that apply when you use planyourevent.com.au and send an enquiry through it.

Last updated: 10 September 2026.

About this service

Plan Your Event is a discovery and enquiry service. We introduce people planning events to independent event planners and coordinators. We do not plan, manage, supply or deliver events, and we are not a party to any agreement you make with a planner.

Enquiries

Sending an enquiry through this site is free and does not oblige you to engage anyone. Submitting an enquiry does not create a booking, hold a date, or guarantee that a planner will contact you or be available for your event.

Your agreement with a planner

Any engagement, quote, contract, payment, cancellation or refund is between you and the planner you choose. You should read a planner's own terms and satisfy yourself about their experience, insurance and availability before you engage them. Plan Your Event is not responsible for the services a planner provides.

Information on this site

Guides, cost ranges and planning information on this site are general in nature and are provided to help you ask better questions. Prices quoted from third-party sources are attributed to those sources and were correct at the time we published them. They are not a quote for your event.

Using the site

You agree not to use the site to send false or misleading enquiries, to collect data from it by automated means, to interfere with its operation, or to use its content commercially without our permission.

Intellectual property

The content, design, branding and code on this site belong to Plan Your Event or its licensors. You may view and print pages for your own planning purposes.

Third-party links

Where we link to another website, we do so because we think it is useful. We do not control those sites and are not responsible for their content or practices.

Liability

Nothing in these terms excludes rights you have under the Australian Consumer Law. To the extent permitted by law, Plan Your Event is not liable for loss arising from your use of this site or from your dealings with a planner introduced through it.

Changes

We may update these terms. The date above shows when they were last changed. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the updated terms.

Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent through our contact form.
